facts.name: Percentage of Participants Experiencing Dose Limiting Toxicities (DLTs) in Safety Run-in (Part 1)
facts.definition: A DLT was defined as a ≥ Grade 3 AE that was assessed as related to either magrolimab or avelumab that occurred during the 5-week DLT assessment period with protocol-defined allowed exceptions
facts.source_quote:
Percentage of Participants Experiencing Dose Limiting Toxicities (DLTs) in Safety Run-in (Part 1)
Time Frame: From the first dose date up to 5 weeks
Description: A DLT was defined as a ≥ Grade 3 AE that was assessed as related to either magrolimab or avelumab that occurred during the 5-week DLT assessment period with protocol-defined allowed exceptions.

facts.name: Percentage of Participants Experiencing Treatment-Emergent Adverse Events (TEAEs)
facts.definition: Treatment-emergent AEs were defined as those AEs that worsened or occurred during or after a participant's first dose of any study treatment and those existing AEs that worsened during the study and within 30 days after the last administration
facts.source_quote:
Percentage of Participants Experiencing Treatment-Emergent Adverse Events (TEAEs)
Time Frame: First dose date up to last dose plus 30 days (maximum treatment duration 18.3 months)

facts.name: Percentage of Participants With Objective Response (ORR) Assessed by RECIST Version 1.1 in Participants With Ovarian Cancer
facts.definition: Objective response was defined as the percentage of participants with objective response which consisted of complete response (CR)+ partial response (PR) determined by RECIST v 1.1
facts.source_quote:
Percentage of Participants With Objective Response (ORR) Assessed by Response Evaluation Criteria In Solid Tumors (RECIST) Version 1.1 in Participants With Ovarian Cancer
Time Frame: From screening until 26.2 months

facts.name: Recommended Phase 2 Dose and Schedule (RP2DS) of Magrolimab in Combination With Avelumab
facts.definition: The RP2DS was the dose of magrolimab in combination with avelumab with DLT rate less than 33% in at least 6 evaluable participants in Part 1
facts.source_quote:
Recommended Phase 2 Dose and Schedule (RP2DS) of Magrolimab in Combination With Avelumab
Time Frame: From the first dose date up to 5 weeks
Description: The RP2DS was the dose of magrolimab in combination with avelumab with DLT rate less than 33% in at least 6 evaluable participants in Part 1.

facts.name: Serum Concentrations of Magrolimab - Safety Run-in (Part 1)
facts.definition: Pharmacokinetic assessment of magrolimab serum concentrations
facts.source_quote:
Serum Concentrations of Magrolimab - Safety Run-in (Part 1)
Time Frame: Predose: (C1D1, C1D22, C2D1,C2D15, C3D1, C4D1, C5D1 [only for 45 mg/kg Part 1], C7D1, C10D1, C11D1 [only for 45 mg/kg Part 1], C13D1, EOT, Safety Follow-up); 1 hour postdose: (C1D1, C1D8); 24 hours postdose: (C1D1, C1D8)

facts.name: Percentage of Participants With Transient Anti-Drug Antibody to Magrolimab - Safety Run-in (Part 1)
facts.source_quote:
Percentage of Participants With Transient Anti-Drug Antibody to Magrolimab - Safety Run-in (Part 1)
Time Frame: From Day 1 of Cycle 1 up to Safety Follow-up (30 days after last dose of magrolimab, maximum treatment duration 18.3 months)

facts.name: Percentage of Participants With Objective Response According to Gynecologic Cancer InterGroup (GCIG) Criteria in Ovarian Cancer
facts.definition: Objective response was defined as participants with a CR or a PR as assessed per GCIG criteria using both RECIST and cancer antigen 125 (CA-125) criteria
facts.source_quote:
Percentage of Participants With Objective Response According to Gynecologic Cancer InterGroup (GCIG) Criteria in Ovarian Cancer
Time Frame: From Screening until 26.2 months
Description: Objective response was defined as participants with a CR or a PR as assessed per GCIG criteria. The GCIG proposed use of both the RECIST and cancer antigen 125 (CA-125) criteria.

facts.name: Duration of Response (DOR) as Per GCIG Criteria in Participants With Ovarian Cancer
facts.definition: DOR: time from initial response (CR or PR) until disease progression
facts.source_quote:
Duration of Response (DOR) as Per GCIG Criteria in Participants With Ovarian Cancer
Time Frame: From initial response until disease progression or maximum time on study (26.2 months)
Description: DOR: time from initial response (CR or PR) until disease progression.

facts.name: Progression-free Survival (PFS) in Participants With Ovarian Cancer
facts.definition: PFS was defined as the duration of time from dose initiation to the first date of objectively documented disease progression per RECIST 1.1 or death, whichever occurred at first
facts.source_quote:
Progression-free Survival (PFS) in Participants With Ovarian Cancer
Time Frame: From first dose date to disease progression, death or maximum time on study (26.2 months)
Description: PFS was defined as the duration of time from dose initiation to the first date of objectively documented disease progression per RECIST 1.1 or death, whichever occurred at first.

facts.name: Overall Survival (OS) in Participants With Ovarian Cancer
facts.definition: OS was defined as the duration of time from dose initiation to the date of death due to any cause
facts.source_quote:
Overall Survival (OS) in Participants With Ovarian Cancer
Time Frame: From first dose date to death or maximum time on study (26.2 months)
Description: OS was defined as the duration of time from dose initiation to the date of death due to any cause. Participants who did not die were censored at their last known alive date.

facts.name: Percent Change of Immune Cells by Immunohistochemistry in Participants With Ovarian Cancer
facts.definition: Paired tumor biopsies analyzed by CD68 immunohistochemistry staining to evaluate the impact of magrolimab in combination with avelumab on macrophage frequency in the tumor microenvironment
facts.source_quote:
Percent Change of Immune Cells by Immunohistochemistry in Participants With Ovarian Cancer
Time Frame: Screening and Day 1 Cycle 3 (Cycle 3 duration: 28 days)
Description: Paired tumor biopsies from participants with ovarian cancer were analyzed by CD68 immunohistochemistry staining to evaluate the impact of magrolimab in combination with avelumab on macrophage frequency in the tumor microenvironment.

facts.name: RECIST Version 1.1
facts.description: Response Evaluation Criteria In Solid Tumors version 1.1 for tumor response assessment
facts.source_quote: Assessed by Response Evaluation Criteria In Solid Tumors (RECIST) Version 1.1

facts.name: Gynecologic Cancer InterGroup (GCIG) Criteria
facts.description: Assessment criteria using both RECIST and cancer antigen 125 (CA-125) criteria for ovarian cancer
facts.source_quote: According to Gynecologic Cancer InterGroup (GCIG) Criteria in Ovarian Cancer... The GCIG proposed use of both the RECIST and cancer antigen 125 (CA-125) criteria.

facts.name: Safety Run-in Cohort
facts.definition: Participants with pathologically confirmed advanced solid tumors
facts.source_quote: Safety Run-in Cohort: Pathologically confirmed advanced solid tumors.

facts.name: Ovarian Cancer Expansion Cohort
facts.definition: Histologically or cytologically confirmed, epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or peritoneal cancer. Checkpoint inhibitor naive participants.
facts.source_quote: Ovarian Cancer Expansion Cohort: Histologically or cytologically confirmed, epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or peritoneal cancer. Checkpoint inhibitor naive participants.
